line: A laser survey strips the canopy off a Connecticut forest and finds 3.4 km of old farm walls.
line_cn: 激光点云剥掉一片森林的树冠，露出当年农田的石墙：3.4 公里。

camera.serves: a claim to test; a before; an ending that returns to the map

camera.move: Crane down with tilt to oblique
camera.expresses: entering the data; the place has height
camera.serves: the switch from picture to cloud

camera.move: Low oblique close to the cloud (10–20° pitch, 90–150 m)
camera.serves: canopy, buildings, a facade, a cliff

camera.expresses: studying, the plane doing the work
camera.serves: a peel; a scan; a held reading

transitions: Transitions are fronts and planes, never crossfades or hard cuts inside the cloud.
labels: Roles: light condensed numerals for readings (110–130 px, e.g. Barlow Condensed 300); a monospace for instruments, coordinates, counts and source lines (19–22 px, e.g. IBM Plex Mono); a sans for labels in the film's language (24–36 px, e.g. Noto Sans SC 500). OFL, self-hosted, CJK subset to the characters used.
Instruments in one corner: place, coordinates, area, data source, point count, any exaggeration; they change only when the medium does.
Readings in the right third beside what they measure: label, number, source/method line; a leader when the feature is in frame; a rolling counter reports its landing value.
Subtitles: a transcript strip bottom-left (2 px rule, plate fading right), one line per language measured with the real font, split rather than wrapped; if bilingual, the film's language on top.
motion: On ones, 24 fps; the camera never stops; keys as a C1 spline in target / distance / heading / pitch (no lookAt from nadir).
The front moves on an ease, slowest where the subject is; a cutting plane steps on the beat (eased steps, short holds) so the layers read.
Points appear behind a front or by height, never by random fade-in across the whole frame.
Readings land with a small pop; traced features light up along their length in order.

native_moves.name: Photo to points
native_moves.does: A scan line crosses an aerial photo; behind it the place is points.
native_moves.fits: a site visit before a design; what the satellite misses; a quarry's real volume.

native_moves.name: The canopy peel
native_moves.does: A plane descends by height above ground, returns above it lift away layer by layer, a ruler tracks it.
native_moves.fits: archaeology under forest; a hidden trail; flood channels; landslide scars.

native_moves.name: Points condense
native_moves.does: A front turns the remaining points into a solid surface; found features light up in order.
native_moves.fits: a building scan to a BIM shell; a cliff to a hazard model; a street to a vehicle clearance model.

native_moves.name: The section
native_moves.does: A plane crosses one feature; the profile glows and a dimensioned chart of the real returns hangs beside it.
native_moves.fits: a levee's height; a bridge's clearance; a road cut.

native_moves.name: The window
native_moves.does: The measured area is a stage inside the unmeasured cloud.
native_moves.fits: a parcel; a corridor; a site boundary.

native_moves.name: The regrowth
native_moves.does: The removed layer returns as a ghost over what was found.
native_moves.fits: an ending; a clearing before/after; a buried pipe under a street.

score.note: FM pings, detuned-saw pads, pulse bass; one wooden timbre when the surface appears
